newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-ESS SHAREHOLDER TO SELL MORE STOCK TO PUBLIC.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-ESS SHAREHOLDER TO SELL MORE STOCK TO PUBLIC.

text.p: A major shareholder in security company Estonian Security Service (ESS) has sold two percent of his stake in the company and will sell another eight percent as the shares are listed on the bourse, the firm said on Tuesday.
ESS finance director Tarmo Keskkula told Reuters that key shareholder Urmas Soorumaa will sell eight percent of the shares to the most active traders in the market to add some liquidity to the stock.
The deal, organised by Hoiu Investments, will be completed in the following weeks, he added.
The issue of ESS shares, which closed a month ago, represents 15 percent of the company's share capital but it needs 25 percent of its shares to be in public hands to get a bourse listing.
